# CEL Lint Integration Tests

# ============================================================
# Section 1: akb lint with CEL lint rules
# ============================================================

exec akb init cel-lint-kb
cd cel-lint-kb

# Write fresh pages
stdin ../fresh-note.md
exec akb write notes/fresh.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/fresh.md'

stdin ../fresh-adr.md
exec akb write decisions/fresh-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/fresh-adr.md'

# Write stale pages
stdin ../stale-note.md
exec akb write notes/stale.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/stale.md'

stdin ../stale-adr.md
exec akb write decisions/stale-adr.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/stale-adr.md'

# Run lint — should find stale pages via cel_lint
exec akb lint
stdout 'cel_lint'
stdout 'adr_stale'
stdout 'note_stale'

# ============================================================
# Section 2: JSON output includes rule_id
# ============================================================

exec akb lint --json
stdout '"cel_lint"'
stdout '"rule_id"'
stdout '"adr_stale"'
stdout '"note_stale"'
stdout '"severity"'
stdout '"warning"'

-- fresh-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Fresh Note
summary: A recently updated note
tags: [linttest]
created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"
---
This note is fresh.

-- stale-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Stale Note
summary: An old note
tags: [linttest]
created: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
---
This note is very stale.

-- fresh-adr.md --
---
type: adr
title: Fresh ADR
summary: A recently updated ADR
tags: [linttest]
status: accepted
deciders: team
created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"
---

# Fresh ADR

## Context

Fresh context.

## Decision

Fresh decision.

## Consequences

Fresh consequences.

-- stale-adr.md --
---
type: adr
title: Stale ADR
summary: An old ADR
tags: [linttest]
status: accepted
deciders: team
created: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
---

# Stale ADR

## Context

Old context.

## Decision

Old decision.

## Consequences

Old consequences.
